idea-plugin.name: LeakLens - Android Memory Leak Detector & AI Fix Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Stop Out-of-Memory (OOM) errors before they reach your users.

LeakLens is the ultimate Android Studio Plugin for Memory Leak Detection and Heap Analysis. It brings the power of LeakCanary’s Shark engine directly into your IDE, enhanced with AI-powered fix suggestions (OpenAI/Gemini).

🚀 Why LeakLens?

Tired of switching between your app, Logcat, and Profiler? LeakLens automates the workflow to find, analyze, and fix Android memory leaks in real-time.

🛠️ Core SEO Features

  • 🔍 Deep Heap Analysis: Capture heap dumps from devices or import .hprof files for instant Shark-powered analysis.
  • 🤖 AI Fix Engine: Use GPT-4o or Gemini Pro to explain complex leak traces and generate Kotlin/Java code fixes.
  • 🛡️ Preventive Inspections: 6+ Static Analysis (UAST) inspections catch leaks as you write code (e.g., Static Activity Refs, Inner Class Leaks).
  • 📊 Real-time Memory Monitor: A built-in graph to track Android JVM Heap usage and trigger auto-dumps when thresholds are hit.
  • 💡 Smart Fix Suggestions: Actionable templates for 11+ common patterns like Context leaks, View Binding, and Handler leaks.
  • 🎯 One-Click Trace Navigation: Click any part of the leak trace to jump directly to the problematic line in your source code.

✅ Compatible With

  • Languages: 100% support for Kotlin and Java.
  • Frameworks: Optimized for Jetpack Compose, Fragments, ViewModels, and Coroutines.

📊 How we compare

  • IDE Integrated: LeakLens is fully integrated into Android Studio, unlike LeakCanary which is an external app.
  • AI Fix Assistant: Get instant code fixes via Gemini/GPT, a feature missing in both the Profiler and LeakCanary.
  • Zero Code Changes: Unlike LeakCanary, LeakLens requires NO SDK or code dependencies in your app.
  • Static Analysis: Catches leaks while you write code (UAST), not just at runtime.

If LeakLens helps you save hours of debugging, please consider leaving a 5-star review! It helps us keep the tool free and updated.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.6 — Compatibility & CI Stability Update

  • Binary Compatibility: Fixed "Method Not Found" errors by reverting to more compatible ddmlib APIs.
  • CI Fix: Resolved GlobalScope inspection test failures by correcting test data markers.
  • SEO & Name: Refined plugin name to LeakLens - Android Memory Leak Detector & AI Fix Assistant for better search and extraction compatibility.
  • Clean Architecture: Further optimized plugin.xml by removing redundant service registrations.

0.1.4

  • SEO Overhaul: Optimized metadata for search terms like "OOM", "Heap Analysis", and "Android Profiler".
  • Marketplace Compatibility: Fixed plugin description formatting (removed tables) to comply with JetBrains standards.
  • Internal Optimization: Removed redundant service registrations to favor modern @Service annotations.
  • Quick Review: Added "Rate LeakLens" action to the Tools menu for community feedback.
  • Ladybug Support: Verified and improved stability for the latest Android Studio versions.

0.1.2

  • Internal API Fixes: Resolved 15 verification errors to ensure compatibility with JetBrains Marketplace standards.
  • Memory Management: Optimized Kotlin Coroutine scopes and explicit Disposable cleanup for better plugin performance.
  • Gradle Stability: Enhanced support for experimental Gradle and Kotlin JVM versions.

0.1.1

  • UAST Migration: Full support for Kotlin and Java static analysis inspections.
  • UX Polish: New IntelliJ UI DSL 2 implementation for a native Look & Feel.
  • ADB Reliability: Optimized device communication for faster Heap Dump captures.
  • Fix Engine: Added professional headers and formatting to AI-powered fix suggestions.

0.1.0

  • Initial release: Integrated Shark (LeakCanary) engine for real-time Memory Leak detection.
